topic: Planning the next cycle from evidence
grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: Planning the next cycle from evidence
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立盲听答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
transcript:
Adviser: This review concerns your training evidence, not a promise of an examination result. Which skill still needs the clearest next step?
Learner: Listening. I answer familiar recordings well, but my performance falls on unfamiliar discussions with several speakers.
Adviser: Then repeating the same recording can build fluency, but it cannot show unfamiliar-task readiness. What evidence will you collect next?
Learner: Two new discussion tasks on different days, with no transcript or vocabulary help before the first answers. I will keep those first attempts separate from later corrections.
Adviser: What about writing?
Learner: I can finish both academic tasks, but feedback still identifies weak comparisons in Task One. I will practise selecting main features, then complete a different chart after a delay.
Adviser: How will you manage the workload?
Learner: Six hours remains a daily maximum, not a minimum to fill. Unfinished feedback and unresolved errors come first. If the next task is unsuitable, I will choose supported practice at the current level.
Adviser: Will a completed calendar mark every skill as ready?
Learner: No. Readiness depends on recent independent work across all four skills. Missing audio or pending reviews remain evidence gaps. The next cycle should target those gaps rather than rename an old task as new.
Adviser: Save that plan with the source work. We should be able to see why each next step was chosen.

grammar.title: 结论强度与情态动词
grammar.explanation: may/could 表示可能；must 表示这里给出的强制规则。根据句中明确说明的证据或规则作答，不把小样本可能性改成普遍必然。
grammar.example: If the next task is unsuitable, I will choose supported practice at the current level.

questions.prompt: The effect _____ vary; the sample is too small to be certain. （只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: may/could 表示可能；must 表示这里给出的强制规则。根据句中明确说明的证据或规则作答，不把小样本可能性改成普遍必然。 本句为：The effect may vary; the sample is too small to be certain.
